_scope_note: Staged pipeline (Section 11): Stage A (area prefilter) + Stage B (cold-start-only, no ALNS) for all 21 candidates; Stage C (full ALNS) only for the 2 newly-discovered markers that ended up in the winning exact-production solution (XS3+XL3, XL1); Stage D (multi-seed) already folded into Stage C's seed counts for those two (2 and 3 seeds respectively). Most Stage-A/B candidates were never promoted to Stage C -- their VALIDATED cold-start numbers are reported as lower bounds, not final ALNS-refined results.
